name: Azure Load Balancer
short_description: Layer 4 Azure load-balancing service that distributes TCP and UDP traffic across virtual machines or scale set instances and uses health probes to send traffic only to healthy instances.

evidence.quote: in Azure, that front desk is usually a load balancer. A load balancer receives incoming traffic
As your load balancer sits lowest and works at layer four, it only sees network traffic such as TCP and UDP
That's Azure Load Balancer and it works great for a single region.
